name: fortify-os-gh-pages
author: Forrest Peterson <Forrest.Peterson@microfocus.com>
description: The Github Pages site for Fortify open source repos.

scripts.dev: concurrently --pad-prefix -c auto -n "gulp,jekyll" "npm -s run watch" "bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --incremental"
scripts.audit: concurrently --pad-prefix -c auto -gq -n "npm,bundle" "npm audit --audit-level moderate" "bundle exec bundle-audit check --update"
